display.purpose: The hero thesis. One per page. Its emphasis phrase is serif italic in the accent.

headline.purpose: Chapter titles and case study section headings.

title.purpose: Pull-quotes and case study standfirsts. Serif because it is display type doing an argument's work.

body.purpose: All reading text, measured 40ch to 68ch, never full-bleed.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, chapter numbers, meta, tags and button text. Uppercase at 0.18em.

shadows.name: object-cast
shadows.purpose: Device mockups and lightbox imagery only. Never a UI surface.

shadows.name: focus-halo
shadows.purpose: The availability status dot. The only ring in the system.

motion.name: ease-editorial
motion.purpose: The single easing curve. Fast out, long settle. Used for every transition and reveal.

motion.name: word-rise
motion.purpose: Hero paragraph words fading up out of a 4px blur, staggered 32ms apart.

motion.name: stagger-step
motion.purpose: Delay between siblings in an index-style list.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single call to action. Its resting fill is the text colour; the accent appears only on hover.

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent with a hairline. Never fills, at any state.
components.html: Resume
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:10px; padding:14px 28px; border-radius:2px; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:600; letter-spacing:.04em; text-transform:uppercase; text-decoration:none; background:transparent; border:1px solid var(--border-strong,rgba(239,237,232,.22)); color:var(--fg,#EFEDE8); transition:border-color .3s, color .3s, transform .3s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color:var(--accent,#E8734A); color:var(--accent,#E8734A); transform:translateY(-2px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline:2px solid var(--accent,#E8734A); outline-offset:3px; }

components.name: Taxonomy Chip
components.description: A label, not a control. Pill shaped, transparent, hairline bordered. No selected state.
components.css: .ds-chip { display:inline-block; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; padding:6px 14px; border-radius:100px; border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); color:var(--fg-2,#A29F98); transition:border-color .3s, color .3s; } .ds-chip:hover { border-color:var(--accent-line,rgba(232,115,74,.45)); color:var(--fg,#EFEDE8); }

components.name: Nav Link
components.description: Muted sans with an accent underline that wipes in from the left and stays for the active section.
components.css: .ds-nav-link { position:relative; display:inline-block; padding:4px 0; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.8125rem; font-weight:500; text-decoration:none; color:var(--fg-2,#A29F98); transition:color .25s; } .ds-nav-link::after { content:''; position:absolute; left:0; bottom:0; width:100%; height:1px; background:var(--accent,#E8734A); transform:scaleX(0); transform-origin:right; transition:transform .35s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-nav-link:hover { color:var(--fg,#EFEDE8); } .ds-nav-link:hover::after { transform:scaleX(1); transform-origin:left; }

components.name: Chapter Head
components.description: The organising device of the whole site: an 88px number gutter, then the content column at 116px. Every block in the chapter aligns to that edge.
components.html:
02
Selected Work

Three problems, told properly.
components.css: .ds-chapter { display:grid; grid-template-columns:88px 1fr; gap:0 28px; align-items:start; padding-top:26px; border-top:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); } .ds-chapter-num { font-family:Newsreader,Georgia,serif; font-size:1rem; font-weight:500; letter-spacing:.04em; color:var(--accent,#E8734A); padding-top:.35em; } .ds-chapter-label { display:block; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.6875rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.18em; color:var(--fg-2,#A29F98); margin-bottom:14px; } .ds-chapter-title { font-family:Newsreader,Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(1.9rem,3.6vw,3rem); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.015em; line-height:1.1; margin:0; color:var(--fg,#EFEDE8); }

components.css: .ds-work-row { display:grid; grid-template-columns:88px 1fr 250px 40px; gap:0 28px; align-items:center; padding:34px 0; border-bottom:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); text-decoration:none; color:inherit; transition:padding .45s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-work-row:hover { padding-left:12px; padding-right:12px; } .ds-work-num { font-family:Newsreader,Georgia,serif; font-size:1rem; color:var(--accent,#E8734A); align-self:start; padding-top:6px; } .ds-work-body h3 { font-family:Newsreader,Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(1.6rem,3vw,2.4rem); font-weight:500; letter-spacing:-.015em; line-height:1.12; margin:0 0 10px; transition:color .3s; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-body h3 { color:var(--accent,#E8734A); } .ds-work-body p { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.875rem; line-height:1.7; color:var(--fg-2,#A29F98); margin:0 0 16px; } .ds-work-tags { display:flex; gap:18px; } .ds-work-tags span { font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.625rem; font-weight:600; text-transform:uppercase; letter-spacing:.14em; color:var(--fg-3,#7B7770); } .ds-work-thumb { aspect-ratio:16/10; background:linear-gradient(135deg,#2a2a2d,#3a3a3f); border:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); filter:grayscale(1) contrast(.95); opacity:.75; transition:filter .5s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1), opacity .5s, transform .5s; } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-thumb { filter:grayscale(0); opacity:1; transform:scale(1.03); } .ds-work-arrow { display:flex; justify-content:flex-end; color:var(--fg-3,#7B7770); transition:color .3s, transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-work-row:hover .ds-work-arrow { color:var(--accent,#E8734A); transform:translate(4px,-4px); }

components.css: .ds-stats { display:grid; grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr); border-top:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); } .ds-stat { padding:28px 28px 0 0; border-right:1px solid var(--border,rgba(239,237,232,.10)); } .ds-stat:last-child { border-right:none; padding-left:28px; } .ds-stat-num { display:block; font-family:Newsreader,Georgia,serif; font-size:clamp(2.25rem,4.5vw,3.25rem); font-weight:500; line-height:1; letter-spacing:-.02em; color:var(--fg,#EFEDE8); margin-bottom:12px; } .ds-stat-label { display:block; font-family:Inter,system-ui,sans-serif; font-size:.75rem; line-height:1.5; color:var(--fg-2,#A29F98); max-width:22ch; }

narrative.overview:
This system behaves like a serious newspaper feature rather than a web app. Content is set in numbered chapters with standfirsts and pull-quotes; structure is drawn with hairline rules rather than boxes; a serif carries every headline while a neutral sans carries every word meant to be read at length. The reader is assumed to be literate and in a hurry, which is the broadsheet's own assumption.

The density is generous and the palette is nearly monochrome. Depth is achieved by ruling and tonal shift, not by lifting things off the page, because paper has no z-axis. One warm accent appears rarely enough that its appearance is information. Both themes are real rather than an inversion: near-black ink and warm off-white paper, each with its own accent value tuned for contrast on that ground.

The confirmed anti-reference is the system this replaced: purple-to-blue gradients, rounded card grids, drop shadows on every surface, and a display face whose hairline strokes read as decorative rather than typeset.
keyCharacteristics: Serif display over sans body, never mixed within a role
Hairline rules instead of cards, borders instead of shadows
Near-zero corner radius; roundness reserved for pills and avatars
One accent, used sparingly, restated per project on case study pages
Numbered chapters as the primary organising device
Motion is triggered by the reader, never ambient

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: The accent never exceeds roughly 10% of a viewport and never fills a resting surface. If it appears twice in one screen region, one of them is decoration and should be removed.

rules.name: The Borrowed Colour Rule
rules.body: A project accent belongs to its case study page and dies at that page's edge. Site chrome, the logo mark and nav, always stays Signal Vermilion, because the nav is the author's identity and not the project's.

rules.name: The Two Voices Rule
rules.body: Serif for anything asserting, sans for anything explaining. A heading never appears in Inter and running body text never appears in Newsreader. The one sanctioned exception is the case study standfirst, an assertion wearing a paragraph's shape.

rules.name: The Weight Floor Rule
rules.body: Display weight comes from --fw-display (500) and is never hard-coded per rule. Newsreader's 400 is a text weight and reads anaemic above 3rem.

rules.name: The Shared Edge Rule
rules.body: Everything within a chapter aligns to one left edge. A block that needs to sit outside it goes full-bleed on purpose rather than indenting differently.

rules.name: The No-Lift Rule
rules.body: A UI surface never leaves the page. Hover changes background or border, never elevation. If something must feel interactive, move it 2px or change its rule colour.

rules.name: The Radius Ladder Rule
rules.body: Four values exist: 0, 2px, 100px, 50%. Anything else is either a mistake or an image's own corner.

dos: Do set every heading in Newsreader at weight 500 through --fw-display.
Do structure a new section as a numbered chapter with an 88px number gutter and content on the 116px edge.
Do build separation from 1px rules and the bg / bg-2 tonal pair.
Do keep the accent under roughly 10% of any viewport and let its rarity mean something.
Do give every animation a prefers-reduced-motion path that lands on the finished state.
Do cap reading measure between 40ch and 68ch.
Do scope a project accent to its own case study page and leave site chrome alone.
donts: Don't put a drop shadow on a UI surface. Depth comes from rules and tone.
Don't introduce a corner radius outside 0, 2px, 100px, 50%.
Don't set body copy in the serif or a heading in Inter.
Don't use a gradient as a surface fill. The one gradient in the system is the hero scrim and its job is legibility.
Don't take a border above 1px; raise its opacity instead.
Don't loop an animation in the reader's peripheral vision. Motion is triggered by scroll, hover or the cursor, and then it stops.
Don't reintroduce em dashes into body copy; the voice uses colons, commas and full stops.
